landing.title: Lodos
landing.subtitle: a restaurant system demo
landing.body: Lodos is a fictional restaurant in Karaköy, built to show a real-time restaurant system end to end. Guests order from a QR menu, the kitchen and bar screens update the moment they do, waiters run the floor and the manager edits the menu. You get your own private copy, so change anything you like. It's a portfolio project by Cem Akçiçek.
landing.tip: Try this: open Guest at T7 in one window and Kitchen in another, then place an order.
landing.fine: No sign-up. Your copy is deleted 30 minutes after you leave.
